Nadia (partnerships): Heads-up: working with CloudOne + Integratek on a joint marketplace launch next month. We need a crisp SI co-sell pre-claim flow so partners don't get blocked and sales reps don't double-touch. Thoughts?
Ethan (sales): Big ask: reps want a visible "partner-reserved" flag for 72h after a marketplace lead is assigned to an SI. That avoids accidental outreach.
Priya (si-ops): 72h OK but add a manual override for partner-ops if SI confirms contact. Also require partner to submit intro email thread before override.
DevBot: New marketplace lead ingested: lead_89012 (acme-devops@example.com) -> tags: marketplace, cloudone, integratek.
Connor (revops): Match algorithm proposal: 1) normalized domain exact match, 2) parent_account lookup (if provided), 3) fuzzy company name threshold 0.9. Prefer parent_account when confidence > 0.92. I'll draft pseudocode: 
```
# match priority
def match_lead(lead):
  d = normalize(lead.domain)
  acct = find_by_domain(d)
  if acct: return acct
  parent = lookup_parent(lead.company)
  if parent.confidence > 0.92: return parent.account_id
  return fuzzy_match_company(lead.company, threshold=0.9)
```
Rita (field-acct): For multi-entity customers, ensure the returned account_id maps to the family root. Also need SLA: if SI claims and doesn't engage within 5 business days, release claim.
Tom (partner-eng): Partners will sign the reservation email with a signed timestamp. Can we attach a partner_claim object in CRM: {partner_id, timestamp, signed_by_email}?
Priya (si-ops): We can't store objects in Slack but the CRM has partner_claim fields. We'll require the intake flow to push partner_claim when SI clicks "Reserve lead" in Partner Portal.
Nadia (partnerships): UX flow suggestion: marketplace -> intake webhook -> staging queue -> partner portal reservation -> 72h reserve -> claim confirmed on signed intro -> ownership to rep. If no signed intro, auto-release after 72h.
Ethan (sales): Edge case: inbound warm leads from joint events where rep already has 1:1 contact. In that case, rep should be able to claim with admin override if they attach convo notes. Add a "dispute" tag so partner-eng can mediate.
DevBot: Intake webhook created ticket P-2211 and posted to #partnerships. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/P-2211
Connor (revops): Domain normalization helper I'm pushing: 
```js
function normalizeDomain(s){
  return s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^https?:\/\//,'').replace(/^www\./,'').split(/[\/:?#]/)[0];
}
```
Priya (si-ops): Also let's add a small audit: every reserve action logs (lead_id, partner_id, portal_user, ip_hash, timestamp). Security needs it for disputes.
Ledger-bot: Audit log entry written: reserve -> lead_89012 by integratek_partner_77 at 2026-02-04T16:12:03Z
Rita (field-acct): Action items: RevOps (Connor) -> confirm match thresholds + publish sample SQL; SI-Ops (Priya) -> update Partner Portal to push partner_claim and signed_intro attachment; Sales (Ethan) -> add dispute tag process; Partnerships (Nadia) -> update playbook and run partner training session next Wed.
Ethan (sales): +1. Also can we make the partner reservation visible in the rep activity feed? Helps reduce noise.
Nadia (partnerships): Good call. We'll add a small UI flag. I'll book training and draft a one-pager. Meeting to finalize rules Wed 9am PT. :spiral_calendar_pad:
Priya (si-ops): I'll prototype the portal change this week and link PR here.
Connor (revops): SQL sample I'll drop in Confluence and link P-2211.
Tom (partner-eng): I'll notify CloudOne & Integratek about the 72h flow and training.
Nadia (partnerships): Thanks team. If anyone hits an edge case ping here or DM me.
